newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Bandits rob Volksbank in Slovakia of $3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bandits rob Volksbank in Slovakia of $3 mln.

text.p: Two armed bandits robbed a branch of Austrian-based Volksbank of 112 million crowns ($3.3 million) on Wednesday on one of the busiest streets of Slovakia's capital, the interior ministry said.

The men, carrying leather suitcases, told the cashier they wanted to deposit a large sum of money and were taken to the vault, where they pulled weapons and tied up female employees of the bank, the ministry said in a statement.
The robbers, assisted by a third male accomplice with a ponytail outside the bank, struck just as it was opening at 8 a.m., and took mostly foreign currency.
Police have closed major roads and issued an alert to all border crossings, the ministry said.
Slovak Volksbank is a unit of Oesterreichische Volksbanken AG.
